domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping/borrowing and simplifying results)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Converts one or both fractions to equivalent forms with a shared denominator prior to subtraction
Converts only the fractional parts of mixed numbers to a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work only subtracts numerators
Only rewrites a whole number as a fraction/mixed number with a chosen denominator to enable borrowing/regrouping (tag S03 instead)
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract aligned quantities
skills.definition: Subtract once quantities are in compatible form (e.g., same denominator and/or separated whole and fractional parts) by subtracting numerators and/or whole-number parts and combining the result.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts like-denominator fractions by subtracting numerators (a/b − c/b)
Subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately for mixed-number expressions and then combines
Computes the difference after any needed denominator conversion or regrouping has already been done
exclusion_criteria: Primary work is finding an LCD and converting to equivalent fractions (tag S01 instead)
Primary work is borrowing/regrouping to avoid a negative fractional subtraction (tag S03 instead)
Primary work is reducing to lowest terms or converting to a final simplified form (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup/borrow to subtract
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole-number part (or rewriting a whole as a mixed form) to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative, then continue the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Fractional-part subtraction would be negative and the solution borrows 1 from the whole part
Decreases the whole part by 1 and adds a full unit fraction (e.g., b/b) to the fractional part before subtracting
Rewrites a whole number into an equivalent mixed form specifically to enable the borrow/regroup step (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3)
exclusion_criteria: No borrowing/regrouping is performed (even if intermediate values are negative but handled by direct combination)
Only converts to a common denominator (tag S01 instead)
Only performs straightforward subtraction once already aligned (tag S02 instead)
Only reduces/simplifies the final fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce fractions (including zero fractions) to lowest terms and express the final value in simplest acceptable form (integer, proper/improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number (or confirms an integer) as final simplification
exclusion_criteria: Only performs subtraction without any reduction or final-form simplification
Only borrows/regroups to enable subtraction (tag S03 instead)
Only finds an LCD and converts equivalent fractions (tag S01 instead)
